args.body: What was our Q3 refund rate in the East region?
Draft: East/Q3 refund rate is 60%. Please check.
How does that compare with the West region, and did it change in Q4?
[from checker] Can you send me the West/Q4 records to spot-check.

West/Q4 spot-check records: r40 refunded=yes 244.10; r41 yes 178.65; r42 no 96.40; r43 yes 530.00; r44 no 72.85; r45 yes 209.30. That is 4/6 refunded = 66.7%. West/Q3 and East/Q4 returned no rows, so those comparisons aren’t calculable. Please review proposed client reply: “West Q4 was 66.7% (4/6), 6.7 percentage points above East Q3’s 60%. There are no West Q3 or East Q4 records, so I can’t determine the like-for-like regional comparison in Q3 or whether East changed in Q4.”
